articles.title: GHSA: Payload: SQL Injection in SQLite and Postgres
articles.summary:
### Impact
A user can submit a request that exploits a SQL Injection vulnerability in Payload.

You are affected if:
- You use an affected Payload version.
- Untrusted users can query readable collections using dynamic filters or joins.

You are not affected if you use MongoDB (`@payloadcms/mongodb`).

articles.title: GHSA: Payload: Untrusted redirect URL parameter exploit
articles.summary:
### Impact
Under certain conditions, an attacker can craft a redirect link that sends a guest user to an untrusted destination after authenticating.

### Patches
Users should upgrade Payload packages to `>= 3.88.0` or `>= 4.0.0-canary.27`.

### Workarounds
Upgrading is recommended. Until then, remove user-controlled redirect values from authentication flows or restrict them to known local paths.
